column2: Description of work

All related Works shall be included under the unit prices. All rates for water supply pipeworks and appurtenances for the above mentioned village shall be indicated in this sheet. Rates for civil structures and ancillary works to include but not be limited to intakes, reservoirs, etc. shall be priced in the adjoining worksheets and are linked to the items in the corresponding row of this worksheet.

Supply, delivery and installation of water pipes, including all fittings and joints necessary for complete installation, pipe trench excavation, pipe bedding / sorrounding, pipe laying / installation, testing, desinfection and backfilling / compaction: machinery or hand trench excavation in any type of soil up to 1,5m depth and dispose of excess material in a dumpsite up to 9 km distance.
